messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the PhoenixEdge outage postmortem. Root causes: intermittent VPC peering flaps + on-prem NAT port exhaustion + tenant isolation bug in cleanup job. Posted full writeup: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/phoenixedge-2026-03. Wanted to capture owners/timelines and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Samir Patel: I'll own the peering stability track. Plan: reproduce flap on staging, increase BGP hold timer defaults, and add health-check-based auto-reconnect policy. Target: 2 weeks (sprint end). @Maya assigning to you for approval on default changes. :white_check_mark:

Priya Rao: OK on two-week target for peering. I'll add perf/latency SLIs to the canary dashboard so we can detect regressions post-change. ETA 10 business days.

Jorge Alvarez: I'll take on-prem preflight checklist for PhoenixEdge installs. Need to add NAT port usage checks + guidance for load balancer conn tracking. Will draft a checklist PR by EOD tomorrow.

Elaine Wu: For isolation bug (tenant cleanup job) — I can own the fix + tests. Root cause is race between controller delete and kv-store cleanup. I'll add an integration test and a defensive backoff. Can we ship patch to Dedicated minor next Tue?

Ron Keller: If we need a short-term customer mitigation, there's a routing policy we can flip that routes PhoenixEdge to warm nodes. Command to apply rollback: 

```
redwoodctl route update --customer phoenixedge --policy warm-nodes
```

Use with caution; will increase cost.

Maya Chen: Action items summary (from above):
- Samir: peering stability plan + BGP default change. due 2w (1767139234).
- Priya: canary SLIs + dashboard. due 10 business days (1766860000).
- Jorge: on-prem preflight checklist PR. due 1d (1766087634).
- Elaine: isolation bug fix + integration test + patch. target next Tue (1766558434).
- Ron: temporary routing mitigation (opt-in) + runbook blurb. due 2d (1766178434).

SupportBot: Customer comms status: Initial postmortem emailed to PhoenixEdge PM. Follow-up scheduled when we have confirmed remediation plan. Ticket #INC-2026-411 created and linked.

InfraBot: Snapshot taken of affected Dedicated pool (snap-2026-03-12-176600). Logs archived to s3://redwood-incident-archives/phoenixedge/1766001234/.

Samir Patel: Confirmed. I'll open the RFC for BGP change and tag @Priya + @Elaine for review. Will also schedule a staging outage window for repro.

Priya Rao: Added the dashboard draft to the repo, link: https://grafana.redwood/d/phoenixedge-peering. Please review.

Jorge Alvarez: PR opened: https://git.redwood/tickets/phoenixedge-preflight-12. Contains checks for NAT port exhaustion and conntrack recommendations.

Elaine Wu: Patch PR: https://git.redwood/infra/tenant-cleanup-fix. Tests added. Requesting quick CI run and canary.

Ron Keller: Routing mitigation runbook updated in ops-runbooks: https://confluence.redwood/ops/phoenixedge-mitigation. Added caution note about cost bump.

Maya Chen: Nice work. Two quick asks: 1) please set the ticket INC-2026-411 to 'in progress' with the above owners; 2) weekly sync on Fridays until all items closed. I'll chair.

Samir Patel: Done — ticket updated and owners set.

Priya Rao: Friday sync added to my calendar.

Jorge Alvarez: Will join Friday sync.

Elaine Wu: Will be on the sync and share test results.

Ron Keller: ACK.

SupportBot: Customer notified of planned follow-up on 3/19.

Maya Chen: Closing thread for now — if anything changes, post updates here. Leaving open until last_message_ts. :pray:
